purpose: Turn established AS2000 evidence into deterministic local validation while separating emulator defects, missing harnesses, infrastructure blockers, and missing external evidence.

policy.REPAIR_REQUIRED: Escalate to Codex only after a reproducible failure against sufficiently established expected behavior and prerequisite regressions.
policy.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Do not invoke Codex. Emit a compact evidence request for GPT, documentation research, external sources, or hardware measurement.
policy.HARNESS_REQUIRED: Do not diagnose the emulator as broken. Build or extend deterministic local instrumentation first.
policy.BLOCKED: Treat missing ROM, wrong diagnostic binary, timeout, failed Lua execution, inaccessible NVRAM, or equivalent infrastructure failure separately from emulator correctness.

invariants.rule: Do not treat HC11 register 0x0001 as an AS2000 boot blocker absent contradictory runtime evidence; current reg01_r() behavior is sufficient for the relevant model.
invariants.evidence_request: Capture the exact 0x0001 access and resulting behavioral dependency before proposing a core change.

tests.expected: Firmware v3.1.4 reaches usable editor state.
Ordinary matrix input produces the intended editor input through the normal keyboard path.
A keyboard matrix transition asserts MC68HC11_IRQ_LINE.
Firmware low-selector write at 0x9000 clears/acknowledges the keyboard IRQ in the current machine model.
F1-F8 select eight distinct legacy file slots through normal firmware behavior.
State written in one MAME process is recovered by a separate MAME process; an in-process reset is not sufficient evidence.
A passing SpellCheck end-to-end test validates dictionary-ROM access and sufficient banking function, but does not establish unmeasured physical net details.
Without an asserted wake source, STOP remains stopped.
Normal keyboard IRQ wakes STOP and vectors normally.
With CCR.X=1, XIRQ wakes STOP but does not vector through 0xFFF4 and does not leave a pending masked XIRQ.
tests.known_current_defect: Current MAME HC11 handling is expected to fail this regression until corrected.
repair_context: check_irq_lines() currently suppresses or ignores XIRQ when CCR.X=1
ordinary keyboard IRQ behavior must remain unchanged

tests.expected: After any XIRQ correction, no asserted wake source still leaves STOP stopped.
After any XIRQ correction, ordinary keyboard IRQ still wakes STOP and vectors normally.
The Send stimulus is resolved and injected as the intended matrix/key event.
The Send event causally reaches firmware dispatch 0x9716.
Execution from the Send dispatch causally reaches retained wired Send entry 0x8606.
The Print stimulus is resolved and injected as the intended matrix event.
The Print event causally reaches caller 0x962D or 0x9804.
Execution from the Print caller causally reaches retained fallback 0xABC9.
Define the minimum real AS2000 SCI behavior required for retained wired transmission before diagnosing emulator SCI fidelity.
tests.evidence_request: Provide observed AS2000 wired-transfer SCI register and line behavior sufficient to distinguish missing emulator implementation from unknown peripheral/protocol behavior.

tests.expected: No emulator behavior is invented until PA7 physical function and any IrDA/wake relationship are established.
tests.evidence_request: Determine AS2000 PA7 physical connection/function and whether it participates in IrDA or STOP wake; prefer continuity, schematic, or direct firmware/hardware correlation.

tests.expected: Production wake source and interval are based on hardware evidence; the prior 1.25 s synthetic interval remains diagnostic only.
tests.evidence_request: Identify the physical AS2000 periodic wake source and measured interval used during auto-off. Do not derive it solely from the 148-count synthetic experiment or manual 3-4 minute observation.
